segments.an4.129:1.3: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:1.4: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:1.5: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.129:2.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:2.2: Tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:2.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.129:3.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:3.2: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:3.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.129:4.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:4.2: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.129:4.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.129:4.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande”ti.

lines: Navame bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāyāti ye bhagavantaṃ passitukāmā theraṃ upasaṅkamanti, ye vā “āyasmā kirānando samantapāsādiko abhirūpo dassanīyo bahussuto saṅghasobhano”ti therassa guṇe sutvā āgacchanti, te sandhāya “bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamatī”ti vuttaṃ.
Dhammanti “kacci, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci yonisomanasikārakammaṃ karotha, ācariyupajjhāyavattaṃ pūrethā”ti evarūpaṃ paṭisanthāradhammaṃ.
Tattha bhikkhunīsu “kacci, bhaginiyo, aṭṭha garudhamme samādāya vattathā”ti idampi nānākaraṇaṃ hoti.
Upāsakesu “svāgataṃ, upāsaka, na te kiñci sīsaṃ vā aṅgaṃ vā rujjati, arogā te puttabhātaro”ti na evaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ karoti, evaṃ pana karoti –
“kathaṃ, upāsakā, tīṇi saraṇāni pañca sīlāni rakkhatha, māsassa aṭṭha uposathe karotha, mātāpitūnaṃ upaṭṭhānavattaṃ pūretha, dhammikasamaṇabrāhmaṇe paṭijaggathā”ti.

129-130. Navame paṭisanthāradhammanti pakaticārittavasena vuttaṃ, upagatānaṃ pana bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañca pucchāvissajjanavasena ceva cittarucivasena ca yathākālaṃ dhammaṃ desetiyeva, upāsakaupāsikānaṃ pana upanisinnakakathāvasena.
